summary: Iteration 31: Daily Watchlist Digest Emails via Resend tested. All 10 backend API tests passed (100%). The enhanced daily digest now includes a personalized Watchlist Intelligence section with health score badge, ticker scores, alerts, and top movers. Scheduler configured for 5:30 AM UTC (pre-gen) and 6:00 AM UTC (digest send).

minor.issue: Resend API rate limiting (5 req/sec) causes some email failures when many users in DB. Not a code bug - expected behavior with free tier.

server.py has _pregen_watchlist_intel() scheduled at 5:30 AM UTC and digest at 6:00 AM UTC
